goal.decided: The user stacks tasks and has an AI work on them through the night, the work resumes once the usage limit lifts, and in the morning the results are checked and taken in. Once it's achieved, an AI stacks tasks at night and lets go, and in the morning checks which tasks finished and which were given up, and takes their results in.
